title: ID0455707-DC/Si-D/AT- [RVP / T9 170005102] bind socket failed Address already in use
description:
Reported behavior/issue: The charging process ended at 90% although this is not set in the truck.
Although the truck is no longer connected to charging point 1, it is still being displayed. On the home screen, it shows "charging completed," but when clicking into it, it indicates that charging is still ongoing.
We recently had the same problem with another customer. The charging cannot be stopped either via the touchscreen or directly through the eCog.
Solution: To be provided in SASW-3001 -> seems to be appointed to 1.7.2 layer
note from ts: in the EcoG we get the error bind address failed -> create a ticket to EcoG -> SASW-3001
note from 12/Nov -> EcoG will take a look at the ticket
